CurrentDutyResponse.description:
Today's duty, with what the dashboard needs to act on it.

Separate from AssignmentResponse so the shared schema stays lean: only this
endpoint carries contact details and the coverage window.
CurrentDutyResponse.title: CurrentDutyResponse

DraftLensSpreadResponse.description: One graded lens in the draft impact preview, before vs after.
DraftLensSpreadResponse.title: DraftLensSpreadResponse

FairnessLensSpreadResponse.description:
One graded lens on the rolling report: the spread between the most-
and least-served member, and whether it fits the acceptance criterion.
FairnessLensSpreadResponse.title: FairnessLensSpreadResponse

PublicConfigResponse.description: Instance settings the UI needs before anyone is logged in.
PublicConfigResponse.title: PublicConfigResponse

RuleViolationResponse.description: One hard rule an edit would break (decision D3).
RuleViolationResponse.title: RuleViolationResponse

ScheduleSummaryResponse.description: A schedule without its assignments, for the drafts listing.
ScheduleSummaryResponse.title: ScheduleSummaryResponse

ScheduleWarningResponse.description:
One warning about a schedule, with the source that produced it.

Merging both sources into bare strings made the solver's own warnings
indistinguishable from the coordinator's rule warnings, and the latter
opened with the word „Korekta" even where nobody had corrected anything.
ScheduleWarningResponse.title: ScheduleWarningResponse

time_budget_seconds.description:
Hard wall-clock ceiling for one whole generation: a generation runs
several solver passes in sequence, so this is what the coordinator
actually waits for.
time_budget_seconds.title: Time Budget Seconds

SwapImpactMemberResponse.description: One side of a swap: the balance now and after the duty moves.
SwapImpactMemberResponse.title: SwapImpactMemberResponse

SwapImpactResponse.description: Projected effect of moving a single duty, shown before the request is sent.
SwapImpactResponse.title: SwapImpactResponse

SwapOptionResponse.description:
One candidate replacement, with what deciding between two of them needs.

The impact preview only appears once a candidate is picked, so comparing
two people any other way means selecting each in turn and remembering the
numbers. These facts travel with the name instead. The current balance
is not among them: `/swaps/impact` already carries it for every option and
the screen fetches those anyway, so computing it again here only made this
endpoint as slow as the whole fairness report.
SwapOptionResponse.title: SwapOptionResponse

SwapPolicyResponse.description: How far a request travels once the replacement agrees.
SwapPolicyResponse.title: SwapPolicyResponse

UnavailabilityConflictResponse.description:
One assignment that lands on a hard `unavailable` entry of the person assigned.

Structured, not prerendered, because the draft matrix counts people and the
409 detail renders sentences from the same list.
UnavailabilityConflictResponse.title: UnavailabilityConflictResponse

UpdateOwnPhoneRequest.description: `PATCH /auth/me`: the one field an account owner may edit themselves.
UpdateOwnPhoneRequest.title: UpdateOwnPhoneRequest

get.description:
The signed-in person's photo, read from the directory on request and
never stored here. `no-store`, so a browser shared by two people never
shows one the other's face from its cache; the interface keeps it in
memory for the session instead.

200.description: The person's own photo as the directory holds it

404.description: No photo: a local account, a share link or none in the directory

the page orphaned the draft in the database with no way back to it.

get.description:
This coordinator's generations that are still in flight.

A screen that shows nothing invites the coordinator to start a second
generation of the same range, which is why a reload must never lose a job
the database still holds.

delete.description:
Discard a draft or a proposal.

Published and superseded schedules are the record of who was on duty, so
they are never deletable; abandoned drafts otherwise pile up in the listing.

get.description: One schedule with its assignments, so a draft survives a page reload.

Newest first. The list is filterable and paged because resolved requests
accumulate forever and would otherwise bury the ones needing action.

schema.title: Response List Swaps Api V1 Swaps Get

get.description:
What this swap would do to both people's balance.

docs/PLAN.md §4 puts a points preview between choosing a replacement and
sending the request. Nothing is written; the projection reuses the same
12-month window as the fairness report so the two never disagree.

schema.title: Response Replacement Options Api V1 Swaps Options Get

get.description:

coordinator. Readable by every signed-in member: the swap screens word the
next step from it.
